name: CYP2D6 inhibition reduces codeine activation to morphine
actions: Evaluate analgesic response and signs of withdrawal when a CYP2D6 inhibitor is added or removed.
Consider an analgesic that does not require CYP2D6 activation when appropriate.

rationale: Codeine requires CYP2D6 conversion to morphine for much of its analgesic effect.
CYP2D6 inhibition increases parent codeine but decreases morphine formation.

explanation_template: {B_name} inhibits CYP2D6 conversion of codeine to morphine. Codeine levels may rise while active morphine levels fall, reducing analgesia or precipitating withdrawal in a dependent patient.

references.source: DailyMed, Codeine Sulfate Tablets, Drug Interactions
references.citation: CYP2D6 inhibitors increase codeine concentration and decrease active morphine, potentially reducing analgesia.
